# Clea

> Clea (clea.no) is a Norwegian AI fashion stylist for fashion and beauty. Shoppers describe the occasion, style or piece they want, and Clea suggests products from more than 1 000 000 items across 15+ online stores, then links them directly to the store to buy. Prices are in Norwegian kroner (NOK). The site is in Norwegian.

Clea er en norsk AI-stylist for mote og skjønnhet. Beskriv anledningen eller stilen med vanlige ord ("noe pent til julebord", "vinterjakke dame under 2000 kr"), få forslag fra mange butikker, og få varsel når favorittene går på salg.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.clea.no/): search across all stores and see popular products
- [Shop by category](https://www.clea.no/shop): dresses, tops, knitwear, trousers and jeans, jackets, shoes, bags, accessories, beauty
- [Stores](https://www.clea.no/brands): every partner store and its products
- [Brands A–Z](https://www.clea.no/merker): 500 brands such as adidas, Nike, H&M, Ralph Lauren and Fjällräven
- [AI stylist](https://www.clea.no/chat): describe what you need and get outfit and product suggestions
- [About Clea](https://www.clea.no/about)
- [FAQ](https://www.clea.no/faq)
- [For partners and stores](https://www.clea.no/partner)
- [Contact](https://www.clea.no/contact)

## Shopping guides (Norwegian)

- [How to shop clothes and shoes smarter online](https://www.clea.no/guide/sammenligne-priser-klaer-sko)
- [Finding sneakers in Norway](https://www.clea.no/guide/billige-sneakers-norge)
- [Choosing a winter jacket](https://www.clea.no/guide/vinterjakke-guide)
- [Price-drop alerts](https://www.clea.no/guide/prisvarsel)
- [Using the AI fashion stylist](https://www.clea.no/guide/ai-moteassistent)

## Product pages

Each product has a page at https://www.clea.no/product/{id} with its price, the stores that sell it, similar products and a price-drop alert.
